/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python - <<EOF
import json, urllib.request
j=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8091/api/trades?sym=ZECUSDT&bars=960", timeout=200))
c=j["cfg"]; print({k:c.get(k) for k in ("tf","stake_mode","stake_base","stake_min","martingale","mart_pct","mart_max","period_from","period_to")})
T=sorted(j["trades"], key=lambda x:x["t_in"])
cum=0
for x in T:
    print("%s ставка %6.2f  net %+6.2f%%  \$ %+6.2f  | профит до сделки %+6.2f" % (__import__("datetime").datetime.utcfromtimestamp(x["t_in"]/1000).strftime("%d.%m %H:%M"), x["stake"], x["net"], x["usd"], cum))
    if not x["open"]: cum+=x["usd"]
print("итого", j["money"])
EOF
